scope: Development complete single-start local optimizer benchmark; not full multi-start search or scientific acceptance
selection: All 10000 cases in existing frozen bank, in existing order, no new states/observations or outcome-based replacement
policy: Existing derivatives.solve_lm arithmetic and convergence criteria; original compiled CPU remains reference. GPU accelerator replaces only residual/Jacobian evaluations using the same batched host state machine as diagnostic CPU adapter.
runs: One uncounted warmup, then 3 repetitions each original CPU with 1/4/all exposed vCPUs, CPU batched adapter once for equivalence/profile, GPU batched adapter 3 repetitions; CPU parallel comparisons include scheduling and result collection
equivalence: First validate CPU state machine against original solve_lm. GPU same-state residual/Jacobian gate remains <=0.001 arcsec and <=1e-6 scaled Jacobian. Report all final convergence/RMS/state differences, including optimizer branch divergence; do not hide or repair disappointing cases.
failure_handling: Numerical invalids and nonconvergence separate; abort timing claims if same-state parity fails. Hard resource stop returns partial, never restarts budget.
resource_limit: One H100, max20min provisioned lifetime, max$1.50 this worker; keep combined prototype/repair/benchmark compute under$5. No other machines. Local development before provisioning. Delete after compact verified results.
profiling: Wall-clock evaluation, optimizer proposal/update, GPU transfer and kernel times; initialization/warmup separate. No claim that historical entire pipeline is profiled.
